title: Export execution artifact
description: Write an artifact to a local file in the export directory, for a client that can read files on the browser machine (after RESULT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED from a records read, or a binary artifact). A remote or sandboxed client pages a dataset with dsagent.artifact.read format jsonl or csv instead.
guidance: Reuse executionId from the error details and the original artifactId, write the artifact to the Extension-managed directory, then analyze the returned local path without inlining the full content.

executionId.description: Opaque execution identifier that owns the artifact.

artifactId.description: Opaque artifact identifier returned by dsagent.artifacts.list or the read-limit error details.

inputSchema.description: Input for exporting one authorized artifact to the Extension-managed local directory.

path.description: Absolute local path of the exported artifact inside the configured managed directory.

mediaType.description: Media type of the exported file.

sizeBytes.description: Exact exported file size in bytes.

outputSchema.description: Local file reference produced by a successful artifact export.
